\begin{strip}
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\footnotesize, >=Stealth,
  box/.style={draw, rounded corners=2pt, align=center, inner sep=3pt, minimum height=0.66cm}]
% ==== (a) bars
\def\ys{0.030}
\draw[black!60] (0,0) -- (6.5,0);
\draw[black!60] (0,0) -- (0,3.25);
\foreach \t in {0,25,50,75,100} {
  \draw[black!60] (0,\t*\ys) -- (-0.06,\t*\ys) node[left, inner sep=1.5pt] {\scriptsize \t};
}
\node[rotate=90, anchor=south] at (-0.55,1.55) {AA, CIL-CORD};
\draw[densely dashed, black!70] (0,\nJoint*\ys) -- (6.5,\nJoint*\ys)
  node[right, inner sep=2pt, align=left] {\scriptsize joint\\[-2pt]\scriptsize \nJoint};
\foreach \x/\v/\c in {0.60/\nNaive/black!28, 1.28/\nNoBank/ourteal, 2.80/\nColar/black!28,
                      3.48/\nSbr/ourteal, 5.00/\nClLora/black!28, 5.68/\nRecall/ourteal} {
  \fill[fill=\c] (\x-0.29,0) rectangle (\x+0.29,\v*\ys);
  \node[above=1pt, inner sep=1pt, fill=white] at (\x,\v*\ys) {\scriptsize \v};
}
\node[below, align=center] at (0.94,-0.03) {no memory};
\node[below, align=center] at (3.14,-0.03) {whole-document\\memory (CoLaR)};
\node[below, align=center] at (5.34,-0.03) {per-session\\isolation};
\fill[black!28] (0.25,3.55) rectangle (0.55,3.75); \node[right, inner sep=2pt] at (0.58,3.65) {shared softmax};
\fill[ourteal] (2.95,3.55) rectangle (3.25,3.75); \node[right, inner sep=2pt] at (3.28,3.65) {session-blocked readout};
\node[anchor=north west] at (-0.8,-0.95) {\textbf{(a)}};
% ==== (b) schematic
\begin{scope}[xshift=8.6cm]
\node[box, minimum width=2.3cm] (tok) at (1.15,0.15) {tokens, boxes, page};
\node[box, minimum width=2.3cm, draw=black!45, pattern=north east lines, pattern color=black!15]
  (low) at (1.15,1.25) {layers $1..k$\\frozen after session 1};
\node[box, minimum width=2.3cm, draw=ourteal, very thick] (up) at (1.15,2.55)
  {layers $k{+}1..12$\\base $+$ delta $\Delta_b$};
\draw[->] (tok) -- (low); \draw[->] (low) -- (up);
\node[box, minimum width=2.7cm, draw=memgreen, thick] (bank) at (4.75,1.25)
  {memory: per-document\\SVD of layer-$k$ latents};
\draw[->, memgreen, thick] (bank.west) -- (low.east) node[midway, above, inner sep=1.5pt] {\scriptsize replay};
\node[box, draw=ourteal, thick] (b1) at (3.45,2.55) {$[\mathrm{O}_1\,|\,\text{tags}_1]$};
\node[box, draw=ourteal, thick] (b2) at (5.05,2.55) {$[\mathrm{O}_2\,|\,\text{tags}_2]$};
\node at (6.05,2.55) {$\cdots$};
\node[box, draw=ourteal, thick] (b3) at (7.1,2.55) {$[\mathrm{O}_B\,|\,\text{tags}_B]$};
\draw[->] (up) -- (b1);
\node[align=center] at (5.25,3.4) {$e_b = 1 - p_b(\mathrm{O}_b)$: the block with the largest $e_b>0.5$ claims the token};
\node[align=left, anchor=west] at (2.75,0.15) {\textcolor{memgreen}{\textbf{CoLaR}} answers drift; \textcolor{ourteal}{\textbf{SBR}} un-shares the\\background; \textcolor{ourteal}{\textbf{Recall}} reads block $b$ under $\Delta_b$.};
\node[anchor=north west] at (-0.2,-0.5) {\textbf{(b)}};
\end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
\captionsetup{hypcap=false}
\captionof{figure}{\textbf{Two causes of forgetting, and a remedy matched to each.} (a) Class-incremental CORD, session-restricted scoring: a whole-document memory alone and a session-blocked readout alone both stay near the naive level; together they come within a few points of joint training, and per-session isolation matches it without a memory, but only when the readout is blocked (\cref{tab:twobytwo}). (b) The memory re-grounds the drifting upper layers (CoLaR); each session gets its own background logit and tokens are routed with no task identity (SBR); SBR-Recall evaluates each block under the trunk delta of the session that created it.}
\captionsetup{hypcap=true}
\label{fig:teaser}
